evals.prompt: Make a 30-second launch video for our app from these screen recordings: rec1.mp4, rec2.mp4. Here's our site: https://example.com
evals.expected_output: Collects inputs (story, formats, music, brand), plans with gates, studies references, writes BRIEF.md and a shot list for approval before building; uses only the real recordings.
assertions: Asks for or confirms the one story / feature to show
Proposes a brief or shot list before rendering
Says it will use the real recordings, not redrawn UI
Plans a measured event table from the render

evals.prompt: v12 is approved. At 44 s the music hits too hard and the merge sound is a bit late. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Treats it as a revision round: measures what peaks at 44 s and the merge frame, changes only those, keeps everything else bit-identical, reports before/after numbers in a new version.
assertions: Measures the 44 s moment before changing it
Checks the merge frame on the picture
Changes only the two things named
Creates a new version instead of overwriting v12

evals.prompt: Give me three music versions of the same launch film with different licensed tracks.
evals.expected_output: Renders the picture once and muxes one soundtrack per version; measures and cuts each track to the same story points; records licences.
assertions: Renders once and muxes per track
Cuts each track to the same story points
Records each track's licence or credit line

should_not_trigger: Write a SQL query that lists users by signup date.
